source: Program.AgentConcurrencyTests.cs in the commit containing this evidence
qualification: local host-neutral smoke; fake Office adapter, no Controller/COM/WebView2/live provider
scenario: 1/2/4/8 recipients plus one idle root; first input -> saved wait -> second input -> same Run completion
samplesPerMetric: one per recipient in each scenario

units.requestCharacters: characters in all flattened model requests; not tokens

boundaries.intakeDurableMs: send entry to durable receipt; destination scheduling is invoked before return
boundaries.idleContextMs: first send entry to first scripted model adapter entry
boundaries.busyContextMs: wake send entry to second scripted model adapter entry
boundaries.wakeNextStepMs: saved checkpoint clearing pending wait to second scripted model adapter entry

limits: participant cap set to workers + 1; no active-step admission scheduler yet
assertions: exactly two model requests per recipient
same Run before and after wait
status listing adds zero model calls
notes: Small local samples are not p95/p99 service guarantees.
Send and provider work are scripted; role negotiation and real coordination token costs are not measured.
The initial run exposed nonblocking first-catalog publication contention, fixed by ed930a76; this records the final run.
